content_of_post_to_answer: Did you know that you wasted a lot of time?
answer: The interesting part about realizing you wasted time is that not all wasted time was actually useless. Some of it was the cost of learning what you value, what drains you, and what distractions you were willing to tolerate. The bigger mistake is not having wasted time; it is continuing to invest in things that no longer deserve your attention. Time becomes truly wasted when awareness arrives but nothing changes afterward.
